marketing.is_advertising_help: Korean advertising email carries a "(광고)" subject prefix, a free opt-out notice, and may not be sent 21:00–08:00.
marketing.list_type_help: A dynamic list re-evaluates its filter every time it is used, so newly imported prospects join it automatically.
marketing.lists_desc: Group prospects by hand, or by a filter that keeps itself current.
marketing.locked_while_sending: Pause the campaign to edit it.
marketing.mapping_help: Map the columns you want as standard fields. Anything you leave unmapped is kept as a source attribute and becomes a filter.
marketing.no_facets: This source carries no filterable attributes yet. Import a file with extra columns and they appear here.
marketing.no_recipients: No recipients yet — build the audience first
marketing.prospects_desc: Cold partner-development list. Convert interested prospects into accounts.
marketing.source_help: Pick where the list came from. The filters below are built from the attributes that source actually carries.
marketing.source_label_help: Groups this batch. The label appears in the source filter and scopes its attribute dropdowns.
